plot_summary:
Theo Appleseed is the protagonist. On Monday Morning, July 29, 2024 at 7:30 am, Theo Appleseed were involved. Theo has a booked train trip to Chicago. Leaving tomorrow at 15:07 pm from the Central Station.
 generate calendar_events for the plot. In the calender event added a note for saving 1h travel time from office. Also he received the ticket number and booking reference number through messages for the train ticket.
user_goal: You want to create an event in your calendar for a train trip to Chicago.

success_conditions.input_text: 1. Create a new event in calendar called Train Trip to Chicago on 30 July 2024 at 15:07 until around 20:00.
2. The creation time recorded on the new entry is at or after the reference time, i.e. it is not backdated.

messages.content: Dear Theo, your train ticket to Chicago is booked. Departure: July 30, 2024, 15:07 from Central Station. Ticket number: TK123456789, Booking reference: BR987654321.

calendars.notes: Train trip to Chicago. Remember to leave 1 hour early from office to reach the station on time.

query: Block my calendar for my Train Trip to Chicago based on the booking confirmation, the trip is about 5 hours long.
reasoning: The user wants to add a new event to their calendar. They have provided the details as a train trip to Chicago so I'll go ahead and use that as the name of the event. I shall look for booking confirmation for the train trip details. I have found a message from 'booking@trainservice.com' said that it'll be tomorrow which is July 30 and the time will be 15:07. The user said the trip is around 5 hours long, so I assume it should be around 20:00. I'll go ahead and create such calendar event.
user_goal_prompt: You are User A, Theo Appleseed. You want to create an event in your calendar for a train trip to Chicago.
